title: Generate bounded random values for generic numeric calculations
goal: Generate simulation integers and binary fractions for supported numeric types, with explicit range bounds and a separate cryptographic alternative.

selectionNotes: Bounded NextInteger<T> requires IBinaryInteger<T>; parameterless generation also requires IMinMaxValue<T>.
Random is noncryptographic. Use RandomNumberGenerator for security-sensitive choices.

runtime.reason: Use the selected numeric runtime contracts and behavior.

language.reason: Canonical sample language mode; no experimental language feature is required.

prerequisites: SDK console project targeting net11.0 with ImplicitUsings=enable and Nullable=enable. Import System.Numerics and System.Security.Cryptography; place the supplied partial class in namespace Playbook.Samples.
constraints: Bounded NextInteger<T> requires IBinaryInteger<T>; parameterless generation also requires IMinMaxValue<T>.
Random is noncryptographic. Use RandomNumberGenerator for security-sensitive choices.
Framework-provided managed APIs; no additional NuGet package/assets, workload, provider or rendering mode. No older-target package route, AOT or native-device execution is established.
stabilityLimitations: Verified using .NET 11 RC2; GA reconciliation remains pending. These selected contracts have no publisher experimental annotation or required opt-in.

evidence.scope: Both targets execute 4,096 simulation iterations, equal/reversed-bound checks and the real cryptographic bounded alternative. RC2 additionally exercises byte and full-width signed Int128 bounds, Half/BFloat16 fractions, double, zero/negative maxima and nonnegative parameterless integers. Actual managed execution; no mocks, cross-compilation or GA verification.
